entry: Only during 03:00-04:00, 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00 New York time, and the setup must form inside the hour.
After a market structure shift toward the draw on liquidity, trade only the first fair value gap that forms and gets repriced inside the hour.
The gap must point at the draw. Enter with a limit at the edge of the gap, filled inside the hour.
exit: One target for the whole position at the draw on liquidity (an untaken high or low). No partials, no breakeven.
Coded choice: close if not hit by 16:00 New York.
stop_loss: Stop just beyond candle 1 of the fair value gap.
filters: The draw must be at least 10 points (40 ticks) away for index futures.

Coded choices: the draw is the nearest untaken level of at least 10 points; a structure shift is a close beyond the last 2-bar fractal swing; any gap of at least 1 tick counts; cancel the limit if the target trades first; costs of 0.7 points per round trip.
